metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Gobi Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing aerosol optical depth (AOD) over the Gobi Desert between February 2020 and February 2019. 1. Data Strategy: - Use MODIS aerosol products (MODIS/061/MOD04_L2 or MODIS/061/MYD04_L2) which provide AOD data - Focus on the 'Optical_Depth_055' band for 550nm AOD - Define Gobi Desert region (approximate polygon covering the desert area) 2. Masking Strategy: - MODIS AOD products already have quality flags, so I'll use the 'Optical_Depth_055' band directly - No additional cloud masking needed as this is aerosol data 3. Logic: - Calculate mean AOD for Feb 2019 and Feb 2020 - Compare the values to determine which is higher - Handle cases of no data or insufficient pixels Let me create a polygon for the Gobi Desert region and implement the comparison. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Gobi Desert region (approximate polygon) var gobi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[90, 40], [110, 40], [110, 45], [90, 45], [90, 40]] ]); // Define date ranges for February 2019 and 2020 var feb2019 = ee.DateRange('2019-02-01', '2019-02-28'); var feb2020 = ee.DateRange('2020-02-01', '2020-02-29'); // Get MODIS AOD data var modisAOD = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_L2') .select('Optical_Depth_055'); // Filter collections for both periods var aod2019 = modisAOD.filterDate(feb2019).filterBounds(gobi); var aod2020 = modisAOD.filterDate(feb2020).filterBounds(gobi); // Check collection sizes var count2019 = aod2019.size().getInfo(); var count2020 = aod2020.size().getInfo(); print(`2019 Images: ${count2019}`); print(`2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean AOD for each period var meanAOD2019 = aod2019.mean(); var meanAOD2020 = aod2020.mean(); // Reduce regions to get mean values var stats2019 = meanAOD2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: gobi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var stats2020 = meanAOD2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: gobi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var mean2019 = stats2019.get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo(); var count2019px = stats2019.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo(); var mean2020 = stats2020.get('Optical_Depth_055').getInfo(); var count2020px = stats2020.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo(); print(`2019 AOD: ${mean2019?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2019px}`); print(`2020 AOD: ${mean2020?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2020px}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count2019px === 0 || count2020px === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020) || mean2019 < 0 || mean2020 < 0) { print("C3"); return; } // Compare AOD values if (mean2020 > mean2019) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
